channel.title: Ronan Keating's Wild Atlantic
channel.desc: Ronan Keating continues his epic journey along Ireland's Wild Atlantic coast. He makes an emotional trip across the waves with his nephew Conall to Clare Island, a special place for the entire Keating family. They get to grips with a traditional loom, before Ronan heads for Sligo to meet up with a fellow boy band veteran, Shane Filan of Westlife, for some horse riding on the golden sands of Strandhill Beach.
